plainText:
Lipica Shah (also credited as Lapica Shah and Lipica Jaclyn) is a voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Shah was born in Monmouth Beach, New Jersey, sometime on December 8, and became an actress as an adult. She first worked on the during . Afterwards, she gained more notable roles during , voicing the Officer Jennys of the Unova region and the Decolore Islands. Shah went on to voice Sima, 's mother, during . In Pokémon Horizons: The Series, Shah gained another major role portraying Geeta.
